$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
if (-not $IsWindows -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) { throw 'Windows pwsh 7 required' }
$baseline = '80d56fd1d6ef666eefe804be7f38de4742dcec43'
$sourcePath = '.github/actions/run-duplicate-function-check/Invoke-DcoirDuplicateFunctionCheck.ps1'
$checkout = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('DCOIR_REPO_ROOT','Machine')
$blob = git -C $checkout rev-parse "${baseline}:$sourcePath"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $blob -ne '6ba6bcc1b8f028399fa91d53f24901a7d20ae905') { throw 'Baseline blob mismatch' }
$source = (git -C $checkout show "${baseline}:$sourcePath") -join "`n"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Baseline source read failed' }
$tokens = $null; $errors = $null
$ast = [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseInput($source,[ref]$tokens,[ref]$errors)
$defs = @($ast.EndBlock.Statements | Where-Object { $_ -is [System.Management.Automation.Language.FunctionDefinitionAst] -and $_.Name -in @('Resolve-CollectorReportPath','ConvertTo-MarkdownTableCell') })
if ($errors.Count -ne 0 -or $defs.Count -ne 2 -or @($defs.Name | Sort-Object -Unique).Count -ne 2) { throw 'Baseline AST mismatch' }
# The separate reviewable test script is gzip/base64 packed solely for bounded transport.
# Its exact SHA-256 is checked before any script is written or invoked.
$testPayload = ''
$inputStream = [IO.MemoryStream]::new([Convert]::FromBase64String($testPayload))
$outputStream = [IO.MemoryStream]::new()
try {
    $gzip = [IO.Compression.GZipStream]::new($inputStream,[IO.Compression.CompressionMode]::Decompress)
    try { $gzip.CopyTo($outputStream) } finally { $gzip.Dispose() }
    $testText = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false,$true).GetString($outputStream.ToArray())
} finally { $outputStream.Dispose(); $inputStream.Dispose() }
$expectedTestHash = 'b74c0293e2394c28a48b9b28d042d45e654346039fe64403191f1d8388b946ae'
$actualTestHash = [Convert]::ToHexString([Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::HashData([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($testText))).ToLowerInvariant()
if ($actualTestHash -cne $expectedTestHash) { throw "Test bytes mismatch: $actualTestHash" }
$testTokens = $null; $testErrors = $null
$null = [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseInput($testText,[ref]$testTokens,[ref]$testErrors)
if (@($testErrors).Count -ne 0) { throw "Native test parser errors: $($testErrors -join '; ')" }
$start = (Get-Location).Path
$scratch = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('dcoir-608-red-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
$owned = $false
try {
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $scratch) { throw 'Scratch path already exists' }
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $scratch -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
    $owned = $true
    $scripts = Join-Path $scratch '.github/scripts'
    $action = Join-Path $scratch '.github/actions/run-duplicate-function-check'
    $null = [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($scripts)
    $null = [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($action)
    $test = Join-Path $scripts 'Test-DuplicateFunctionCheckPaths.ps1'
    $helper = Join-Path $action 'DuplicateFunctionCheck.Paths.ps1'
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($test,$testText,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    $pwsh = (Get-Process -Id $PID).Path
    $output = @(& $pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File $test 2>&1)
    $exit = $LASTEXITCODE
    if ($exit -eq 0 -or ($output -join "`n") -notmatch 'Missing production path helper') { throw "Expected missing-helper RED not observed: $($output -join ' ')" }
    Write-Output "RED_MISSING_HELPER exit=$exit"
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($helper,(($defs | ForEach-Object { $_.Extent.Text }) -join "`n`n"),[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    $output = @(& $pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File $test 2>&1)
    $exit = $LASTEXITCODE
    if ($exit -eq 0 -or ($output -join "`n") -notmatch 'Expected path rejection not observed: ambiguous path component') { throw "Expected legacy RED not observed: $($output -join ' ')" }
    Write-Output "RED_LEGACY_ACCEPTED_AMBIGUOUS_PATH exit=$exit"
    Write-Output "NATIVE_RED_COMPLETE test_sha256=$actualTestHash baseline=$baseline blob=$blob pwsh=$($PSVersionTable.PSVersion)"
} finally {
    Set-Location -LiteralPath $start
    if ($owned) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $scratch -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop }
}
Write-Output 'RED_SCRATCH_CLEANUP_COMPLETE'
# All intentionally nonzero children were checked above. Do not propagate expected RED to wrapper.
$global:LASTEXITCODE = 0
